ripgrep (rg.exe) — bundled with LocoHelperAI

Source:  https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/releases
License: MIT OR Unlicense (see LICENSE-MIT and UNLICENSE in this folder)
Author:  Andrew Gallant (BurntSushi)

The bundled binary in Win64/rg.exe is the official upstream ripgrep release
for x86_64-pc-windows-msvc. To update to a newer version, download the latest
release from the URL above and replace Win64/rg.exe.

LocoHelperAI invokes this binary from FCodeSearchTool / FRipgrepRunner to
expose grep, find_symbol, find_references, and read_file MCP tools to AI agents.
ripgrep is unmodified from upstream and used as a separate executable via
subprocess invocation — no linking, no derivative work.
